query: Detail Miami car wash, Miami, FL
name: Detail Miami
niche: mobile auto detailing / car wash (luxury and exotic vehicles)
hours: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Sunday closed

reviewSamples.author: Eric Bartos
reviewSamples.text: 5 Stars all the way! I have some very high end vehicles and I am never disappointed when I get them back.

reviewSamples.author: Paul Kovalenko
reviewSamples.text: One of the best car washes i recieved! Both operators of the company are great people as well.

reviewSamples.author: Alejandro Elias Siwady
reviewSamples.text: I recently had my vehicle detailed at Detail Miami Car Wash, and I couldn't be happier with the results.

reviewSamples.author: Christopher Portugal
reviewSamples.text: Best car wash in town! They've been washing my car for over 8 years, and the quality is always outstanding.

reviewSamples.author: Mark Kreindel
reviewSamples.text: These guys are the best! DetailMiami has been doing my car for years.

notes: Mobile-only detailing business: Google Business Profile (business.google.com/v/detail-miami/01549356587429898936/8766/_) lists no street address, only a service area of Miami FL, Broward County FL and Miami-Dade County FL, and explicitly describes the business as mobile. Confirmed via WebFetch and a direct curl of the business.google.com page (Chrome UA): phone (786) 512-8450, rating 4.9, 58 reviews, description 'Superior mobile detailing services specializing in luxury and exotic automobiles!', categories Auto detailing / Car waxing, hours Mon-Sat 9AM-7PM (Sun closed). No website, Instagram or Facebook link present on the profile. Deep search per pipeline fase 1.7 (web search for Instagram/Facebook/email combinations, phone number, and 'Detail Miami' + variants) found no public email, no Instagram handle, no Facebook page, and no Sunbiz FL corporate registration under this name, so an owner/contact name could not be confirmed beyond 'two operators' mentioned in Paul Kovalenko's review. All 5 verbatim reviews are in English with no Spanish evidence anywhere (reviews, business description), so language is set to en with full es translations built into the site's bilingual toggle. 9 real photos recovered directly from the business's Google Business Profile photo payload (lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/... URLs), downloaded at 1200x1600 and resized to 1000px wide for performance; all 9 verified as genuine JPEGs with `file` and visually reviewed one by one: Ferrari foam wash in an indoor garage, a Lamborghini Revuelto with scissor door open, a Bugatti Chiron (exterior and blue leather interior), a Ferrari F8 at a hotel portico, a Ferrari F12 and McLaren P1 parked at a job site, a green McLaren P1, a yellow Lamborghini Urus, and two operators foam-washing a pair of Rolls-Royce vehicles together (confirms the 'both operators' detail from the Kovalenko review). No fabricated address, map, logo, pricing or named service packages were used anywhere; pricing is presented as quote-based per the adapted variant for non-booking mobile businesses.
